description: This file defines functions and types for managing channel secrets, including retrieving channel records, surfaces, and handling secret input assignments for channels and nested structures, with support for account-specific overrides and TTS API key collection.

methods.name: getChannelRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific channel record from the configuration based on the channel key.

methods.name: getChannelSurface
methods.description: Returns the channel record and its surface information for a given channel key.

methods.name: resolveChannelAccountSurface
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the surface information for a channel, including account enablement and explicit account presence.

methods.name: isBaseFieldActiveForChannelSurface
methods.description: Determines if a base field is active for a given channel surface based on account enablement and property presence.

methods.name: normalizeSecretStringValue
methods.description: Trims and returns a string value or empty string if not a string.

methods.name: hasConfiguredSecretInputValue
methods.description: Checks if a secret input value is configured, considering defaults and secret references.

methods.name: collectSimpleChannelFieldAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret input assignments for a simple channel field, including account-specific overrides.

methods.name: collectConditionalChannelFieldAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret input assignments for a conditional channel field, considering account activation predicates.

methods.name: collectNestedChannelFieldAssignments
methods.description: Collects secret input assignments for nested channel fields, including account-specific nested structures.

methods.name: collectNestedChannelTtsAssignments
methods.description: Collects TTS API key assignments for nested channel structures, including account-specific nested TTS data.
